aboutPage.seoDesc: The journey, mission, values and team of Unite Foundation.
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Unite Foundation is a non-political, non-profit Islamic platform — dedicated to da'wah, education and social welfare in the light of the Qur'an and authentic Hadith.
goals: Convey the message of the Holy Qur'an and authentic Hadith to all people.
Shape young people and students into capable, God-conscious callers to Allah.
Raise awareness in society about correct beliefs and practices.
Formulate and implement policies for Islamic education and culture.
Publish books and authentic translations on Islamic topics.

values.d: Dedicated to shaping life in the light of the Qur'an and authentic Hadith.
Complete and public accounting of every taka.
Measurable results in da'wah, education and social welfare.
A shared journey of donors, volunteers and beneficiaries.

aboutPage.milestonesIntro: The journey of Unite Foundation began with a beautiful dream and a firm determination to do something for humanity. That small beginning in 2017 has today grown into a vast humanitarian tree. Below are our notable milestones —
aboutPage.milestonesQuote: The small sapling planted in 2017 with only 10 volunteers has, by 2026, grown into a vast 'tree' of service to countless people.
aboutPage.founderBio: The pathfinder of a journey that began from a dream — his aspiration is to build a disciplined, transparent and long-lasting Islamic platform dedicated to humanity in the way of the Sunnah.
aboutPage.founderTagline: A caller and organiser dedicated to serving humanity in the way of the Sunnah.
